SELECT
	ReportOrder,
	SubOrder, 
	ReportGroup,
	Remarks,
	Amount = ISNULL(SUM(Amount), 0),
	CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(CashAmount), 0)
FROM
	(SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 1,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Opening Balances',
		Remarks = A.Name,
		Amount = 0.00,
		CashAmount = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND V.Date < :adt_StartDate), 0)
	FROM 
		Accounts A
	WHERE SubCode IN 
		(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 2,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Sales',
		Remarks = 'Cash Sales' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(SL.SaleInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(SL.InvTotal),0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(SL.InvTotal),0)
	FROM 
		SaleLedger SL
	WHERE 
		SL.SaleCatCode IN (1,3) AND 
		SL.Posted = 'Y' AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 2,
		SubOrder = 2,
		ReportGroup = 'Sales',
		Remarks = 'Credit Sales' + ISNULL(' (' + (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(S.SaleInvCode))))  FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleCatCode NOT IN (1,3) AND S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(SL.InvTotal), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(SL.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(S.Amt)
				FROM SaleLedger S 
				WHERE 
					S.Amt > 0 AND 
					S.PaymentAccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(S.Amt)
				FROM SaleLedger S, CashierWindow CW
				WHERE 
					S.SaleInvCode =CW.SaleInvCode AND 
					CW.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		SaleLedger SL
	WHERE 
		SL.SaleCatCode NOT IN (1,3) AND
		SL.Posted = 'Y' AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 3,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Sales Return',
		Remarks = 'Cash Sales Return' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(SL.SRInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(SL.InvTotal), 0),
		CashAmount = - ISNULL(SUM(SL.InvTotal), 0)
	FROM 
		SRLedger SL
	WHERE 
		SL.SRCatCode IN (6,8) AND
		SL.Posted = 'Y' AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 3,
		SubOrder = 2,
		ReportGroup = 'Sales Return',
		Remarks = 'Credit Sales Return' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(SL.SRInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(SL.InvTotal), 0),
		CashAmount = - ( ISNULL(SUM(SL.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(S.Amt)
				FROM SRLedger S 
				WHERE 
					S.Amt > 0 AND 
					S.PaymentAccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(S.Amt)
				FROM SRLedger S, MasterCashWin CW
				WHERE 
					CW.DocumentType = 'SR' AND 
					CW.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode AND 
					CW.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					CW.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0) )
	FROM 
		SRLedger SL
	WHERE 
		SL.SRCatCode NOT IN (6,8) AND
		SL.Posted = 'Y' AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 4,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Purchases',
		Remarks = 'Purchases' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(PL.PurInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(PL.InvTotal), 0),
		CashAmount = - 
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(S.Amt)
				FROM PurLedger S 
				WHERE 
					S.Amt > 0 AND 
					S.PaymentAccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		PurLedger PL
	WHERE
		PL.Posted = 'Y' AND
		PL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 5,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Purchases Return',
		Remarks = 'Purchases Return' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(PL.PRInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(PL.InvTotal), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(
			(SELECT SUM(S.Amt)
			FROM PRLedger S 
			WHERE 
				S.Amt > 0 AND 
				S.PaymentAccCode IN 
					(SELECT AA.AccCode 
					FROM Accounts AA
					WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
				S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		PRLedger PL
	WHERE
		PL.Posted = 'Y' AND
		PL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 6,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Services',
		Remarks = 'Cash Services' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(S.ServiceInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(S.ServiceInvCode)), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(S.ServiceInvCode)), 0)
	FROM 
		ServiceHeader S
	WHERE 
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND
		S.ServiceCatCode IN (10) AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 6,
		SubOrder = 2,
		ReportGroup = 'Services',
		Remarks = 'Credit Services' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(S.ServiceInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(S.ServiceInvCode)), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(S.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(CW.Amount)
				FROM ServiceHeader SS, MasterCashWin CW
				WHERE 
					CW.DocumentType = 'RS' AND 
					CW.DocumentCode = SS.ServiceInvCode AND 
					CW.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					CW.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		ServiceHeader S
	WHERE 
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND
		S.ServiceCatCode NOT IN (10) AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 7,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Service Return',
		Remarks = 'Cash Service Return' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(S.ServiceRInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_GetServiceReturnInvTotal(S.ServiceRInvCode)), 0),
		CashAmount = - ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_GetServiceReturnInvTotal(S.ServiceRInvCode)), 0)
	FROM 
		ServiceRHeader S
	WHERE 
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND
		S.ServiceRCatCode IN (13) AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 7,
		SubOrder = 2,
		ReportGroup = 'Service Return',
		Remarks = 'Credit Service Return' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(S.ServiceRInvCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_GetServiceReturnInvTotal(S.ServiceRInvCode)), 0),
		CashAmount = -1 * (ISNULL(SUM(S.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(CW.Amount)
				FROM ServiceRHeader SS, MasterCashWin CW
				WHERE 
					CW.DocumentType = 'RR' AND 
					CW.DocumentCode = SS.ServiceRInvCode AND 
					CW.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					CW.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0))
	FROM 
		ServiceRHeader S
	WHERE 
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND
		S.ServiceRCatCode NOT IN (13) AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 8,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Patient Registration',
		Remarks = 'Patients Registered ' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(P.PatientCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(P.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(CW.Amount)
				FROM Patient PP, MasterCashWin CW
				WHERE 
					CW.DocumentType = 'PG' AND CW.DocumentCode = PP.PatientCode AND 
					CW.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(P.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(CW.Amount)
				FROM Patient PP, MasterCashWin CW
				WHERE 
					CW.DocumentType = 'PG' AND 
					CW.DocumentCode = PP.PatientCode AND 
					CW.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					CW.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		Patient P
	WHERE 
		P.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 9,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Patient Admission',
		Remarks = 'Patients Admitted ' + ISNULL(' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(P.AdmissionCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(P.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(CW.Amount)
				FROM PatientAdmission PP, MasterCashWin CW
				WHERE 
					CW.DocumentType = 'PG' AND CW.DocumentCode = PP.AdmissionCode AND 
					CW.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(P.CashCharged), 0) +
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(CW.Amount)
				FROM Patient PP, MasterCashWin CW
				WHERE 
					CW.DocumentType = 'PG' AND 
					CW.DocumentCode = PP.PatientCode AND 
					CW.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					CW.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		PatientAdmission P
	WHERE 
		P.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 10,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Transaction Window - Receipts',
		Remarks = TT.Name + ISNULL(' - (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(T.DocumentCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(T.CashCharged), 0) + 
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(D.Amount)
				FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionDetail D, TransactionType TTP
				WHERE 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = T.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = TTP.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.DocumentCode = D.DocumentCode AND 
					TH.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(T.CashCharged), 0) + 
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(D.Amount)
				FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionDetail D, TransactionType TTP
				WHERE 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = T.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = TTP.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.DocumentCode = D.DocumentCode AND 
					D.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					TH.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		TransactionHeader T, TransactionType TT
	WHERE 
		T.Posted = 'Y' AND
		T.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate AND
		T.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
		TT.TransactionCatCode = 1
	GROUP BY
		T.TransactionTypeCode,
		TT.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 11,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Transaction Window - Payments',
		Remarks = TT.Name + ISNULL(' - (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(COUNT(T.DocumentCode)))) + ')',''),
		Amount = - (ISNULL(SUM(T.CashCharged), 0) + 
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(D.Amount)
				FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionDetail D, TransactionType TTP
				WHERE 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = T.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = TTP.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.DocumentCode = D.DocumentCode AND 
					TH.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0)),
		CashAmount = - (ISNULL(SUM(T.CashCharged), 0) + 
			ISNULL(
				(SELECT SUM(D.Amount)
				FROM TransactionHeader TH, TransactionDetail D, TransactionType TTP
				WHERE 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = T.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.TransactionTypeCode = TTP.TransactionTypeCode AND 
					TH.DocumentCode = D.DocumentCode AND 
					D.AccCode IN 
						(SELECT AA.AccCode 
						FROM Accounts AA
						WHERE AA.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
					TH.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate), 0))
	FROM 
		TransactionHeader T, TransactionType TT
	WHERE 
		T.Posted = 'Y' AND
		T.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate AND
		T.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
		TT.TransactionCatCode = 2
	GROUP BY
		T.TransactionTypeCode,
		TT.Name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 16,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Others',
		Remarks = 'Cash Receipts',
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(V.Debit), 0),
		CashAmount = ISNULL(SUM(V.Debit), 0)
	FROM 
		VirtualGL V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR', 'PV','PR','RS','RR','PG','PA') AND
		V.DocumentType NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TT.ShortName FROM TransactionType TT WHERE TT.Posted='Y') AND
		V.AccCode IN 
			(SELECT A.AccCode 
			FROM Accounts A
			WHERE A.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
		V.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 16,
		SubOrder = 2,
		ReportGroup = 'Others',
		Remarks = 'Cash Payments',
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(V.Credit), 0),
		CashAmount = - ISNULL(SUM(V.Credit), 0)
	FROM 
		VirtualGL V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR', 'PV','PR','RS','RR','PG','PA') AND
		V.DocumentType NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TT.ShortName FROM TransactionType TT WHERE TT.Posted='Y') AND
		V.AccCode IN 
			(SELECT A.AccCode 
			FROM Accounts A
			WHERE A.SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) AND
		V.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportOrder = 18,
		SubOrder = 1,
		ReportGroup = 'Closing Balances',
		Remarks = A.Name,
		Amount = 0.00,
		CashAmount = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(V.Debit - V.Credit) FROM VirtualGL V WHERE V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND V.Date <= :adt_EndDate), 0)
	FROM 
		Accounts A
	WHERE SubCode IN 
		(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub')) T
GROUP BY
	ReportOrder,
	SubOrder,
	ReportGroup,
	Remarks
ORDER BY
	ReportOrder,
	SubOrder,
	ReportGroup,
	Remarks
